dataset_name: CropYield-ST Haryana, India (Karnal Rice-Wheat Belt) Field Dataset
description: Multi-sensor Sentinel-1/2 time series and yield labels for 36 contiguous parcels

sensors.optical: Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A (B2 Blue, B4 Red, B5 RedEdge, B8 NIR, B11 SWIR)
sensors.radar: Sentinel-1 C-band SAR GRD (VV, VH dual polarization)

target_variable: yield_tha (Crop yield in tonnes per hectare)
disclaimer: This sample dataset is calibrated for algorithm verification and faculty evaluation.
